items.title: Trevor Lawrence: Tosses two TDs in Week 5 win
items.text:
Lawrence completed 24 of 39 passes for 331 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles. He added 25 rushing yards on three carries and lost one of two fumbles.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Tops 90 scrimmage yards against Philly
items.text:
Tuten carried the ball 22 times for 72 yards and caught two of three targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
